en: Color postcard showing a sunset over the Black Sea from a wrought‑iron seaside terrace with tables, chairs and two ornate lamp posts; a person stands in silhouette watching the sun. The reverse side is a Romanian postcard form with a POSTA ROMANA 55B stamp and cancellation, published by Editura Sport‑Turism. It is addressed to Udrescu Vasile in București. Printed caption mentions România and Eforie Nord with multilingual translations for "sunset."
